title: Dashboard configuration
description: Companion to the metrics files. Cross-checks (unknown/missing names) are done by validate_metrics.py and serialize_json.py. Paths are node names joined with '/'.

labels.description: Flat map of node name (category or metric) -> label (string).

units.description: Flat map of metric name -> target unit (string). Those units are a source of truth for any incoming metric sets. If diverged, the units get converted to the ones described by the config file.

date.description: Path of the metric holding the run date (X axis of the trend plots).

commit.description: Path of the metric identifying the run's commit/version, presented as is.

summary.description: Paths of the metrics to be presented in the run summaries.

unplottable.description: Categories or metrics excluded from plotting: a bare name matches the node anywhere in the hierarchy, a path matches that node (and everything below it).
